longChainMethod: 500 and 1000 accepted growing-topology stages; one changed tip per preview, three distinct heights per new Router/Worker, four pairs per size in AB/BA/AB/BA order. Both arms use the same frozen predecessor evaluator version and isolated result keys. Compare exact BREP, Naming and final GLB hashes. First = four new-process previews, subsequent = eight edits per arm/size. OS and database caches retained.
plateMethod: 610 x 60 x 6 mm, 10 positioning points on XY at x=3 and y=3+6*i. Simple engineering Hole with diameter 2 and fixed depth 8 traverses plate. One linear pattern in X, total columns 10/50/100 including seed column, pitch 6 then 6.1 mm. Independent documents per size/arm/repetition, normal production keys, AB then BA. Measure preview/commit separately; seed construction, volume queries and forced cold replay excluded. Validate one Worker evaluation per preview, same preview/committed BREP/Naming/GLB, number of faces, material volume, moved geometry and Head. Cold replay checks BREP and Naming within document; independent documents are compared by checked topology and exact volume, not by byte identity.
